article.story: RADFORD, Va. -- — Nolan Hodge scored 18 points as UNC Wilmington beat Radford 81-73 on Friday. Hodge also contributed seven rebounds for the Seahawks (4-1). Gavin Walsh scored 15 points while shooting 7 for 14 from the floor. Christian May had 11 points. The Highlanders (2-5) were led by Dennis Parker Jr. and Del Jones with 27 points apiece. UNC Wilmington took the lead with 18:08 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Walsh led the team in scoring with eight points in the first half to help put them ahead 31-27 at the break. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
